//----- Green flag events ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
    Event.Broadcast("GF");
    Forever
    {
        If Sensing.KeyPressed(r)
        {
            If (List.ContainsItem(textlog, "Congratulations! You have defeated the all-mighty bringer of evil *S U D O  G O D*!") Or (PlayerHp == 0))
            {
                Stop(other scripts in sprite);
                Event.BroadcastAndWait("sosis");
                Event.Broadcast("GF");
                PlayerHp = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}


//----- Broadcast received events -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WhenBroadcastReceived(Ending)
{
    Stop(other scripts in sprite);
    Forever
    {
        Sound.PlayUntilDone(Ending);
    }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(GF)
{
    Sound.SetEffectTo(PITCH, -109);
    PlayerLevel = 1;
    floor = 1;
    PlayerPower = 8;
    PlayerExp = 0;
    PlayerHp = 20;
    PlayerMaxFull = 100;
    PlayerWeaponStrength = 0;
    PlayerShieldStrength = 0;
    PlayerMoney = 0;
    player's status = 0;
    PlayerScorept1 = 1;
    List.DeleteAll(maps);
    List.DeleteAll(inventory);
    List.Add(inventory, 49);
    List.Add(inventorycount, "");
    List.Add(equipped, 0);
    PlayerAdditionalHp = 0;
    inventoryopen = 0;
    PlayerFull = 100;
    Forever
    {
        PlayerAtk = (((log(((PlayerLevel / 3) + 2)) * 25) + ((PlayerWeaponStrength + (PlayerPower + ((inventory[List.IndexOf(equipped, "Armband")] == 18) * 3))) * (log(((PlayerLevel / 1.5) + 2)) / (((PlayerLevel > 12) * (log(((PlayerLevel / 1.5) + 2)) - 1)) + 1)))) - 7);
        If (PlayerExp > (exp table[PlayerLevel] - 1))
        {
            If (PlayerLevel < 99)
            {
                Call LvUP;
                Sound.Play(Level Up);
                List.Add(textlog, Operator.Join(Operator.Join("You reached level ", PlayerLevel), "."));
            }
        }
        PlayerMaxHp = Operator.Round((Operator.Round(((((PlayerLevel * 4.207) + ((PlayerLevel % 3.8) / 2.56)) + ln(((PlayerLevel * 1.1) - 1))) + (PlayerAdditionalHp + 19))) - e ^((PlayerLevel / 26))));
        If (PlayerMaxHp > 300)
        {
            PlayerMaxHp = 300;
        }
        If (PlayerExp > 999999)
        {
            PlayerExp = 999999;
        }
        PlayerWeaponStrength = ((weapon/shield power[inventory[List.IndexOf(equipped, "Weapon")]] + inventorycount[List.IndexOf(equipped, "Weapon")]) / 1.25);
        PlayerShieldStrength = ((weapon/shield power[inventory[List.IndexOf(equipped, "Shield")]] + inventorycount[List.IndexOf(equipped, "Shield")]) / 1.5625);
    }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(GF)
{
    List.DeleteAll(textlog);
    List.DeleteAll(inventorycount);
    Forever
    {
        played12 = 0;
        If ((Not (List.ContainsItem(MH floors, floor))) And (Not (((musics[floor] == 9) And (music == 10)))))
        {
            music = musics[floor];
        }
        Wait Until (Not (((music == musics[floor]) Or ((musics[floor] == 9) And (music == 10)))));
        If ((Not (List.ContainsItem(MH floors, floor))) And (Not (((musics[floor] == 9) And (music == 10)))))
        {
            Sound.StopAllSounds();
        }
    }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(GF)
{
    Forever
    {
        If List.ContainsItem(MH floors, floor)
        {
            music = 12;
            Sound.StopAllSounds();
            Wait Until (Not (List.ContainsItem(MH floors, floor)));
            Sound.StopAllSounds();
        }
    }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(StartGame)
{
    Control.Wait(0.2);
    Forever
    {
        Sound.PlayUntilDone(music);
        If ((musics[floor] == 9) And (music == 9))
        {
            If (played12 == 1)
            {
                music = 10;
            }
            Else
            {
                played12 = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}


//----- Custom blocks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Define LvUP (warp=true)
{
    Repeat Until ((Not ((PlayerExp > (exp table[PlayerLevel] - 1)))) Or (PlayerLevel > 98))
    {
        PlayerLevel += 1;
        PlayerHp += (Operator.Round((Operator.Round(((((PlayerLevel * 4.207) + ((PlayerLevel % 3.8) / 2.56)) + ln(((PlayerLevel * 1.1) - 1))) + (PlayerAdditionalHp + 14))) - e ^((PlayerLevel / 26)))) - Operator.Round((Operator.Round((((((PlayerLevel - 1) * 4.207) + (((PlayerLevel - 1) % 3.8) / 2.56)) + ln((((PlayerLevel - 1) * 1.1) - 1))) + (PlayerAdditionalHp + 14))) - e ^(((PlayerLevel - 1) / 26)))));
    }
}
